usability.text: Read index map <class>.IadSm173F35X, using the given %SQLUPPER(Name), and looping on ID.

not_inferred: datatypes (they belong to the class's properties, not the map)
collations (whether the class compares text case-sensitively)
index maps (an index global such as ^X.x is not linked to this map)
conditions (a conditional map or an index that skips rows)
computed subscripts (levels produced by code, such as a $BIT chunk)
the ID counter (SqlIdExpression) and any row ID built from several parts
COLLATE (a subscript collated by %COLLATE is recognised and never drafted)
numeric collations (PLUS and MINUS are not map-expression functions, so a subscript they produce is not drafted)
computed subscripts in an index (a subscript made by code, such as a date format, is reported as not explained and no code is guessed)
